zh.time.title: 时域与电平
zh.time.gaps_hint: 缺口来自流元数据；波形跨缺口断开，不静默填充。
zh.time.cursor_hint: 在图表内滚轮缩放时间轴、拖拽平移、双击适配全图；游标吸附显示点。
zh.time.display_only: 仅显示抽取：不作为测量数值导出。
zh.time.channel_hint: 通道显隐在页面顶部切换；六通道颜色全应用固定。
zh.bands.title: 1/3 倍频程
zh.bands.run: 运行离线参考频带分析
zh.bands.need_replay: 请先在“记录与回放”打开录制文件；本页不会自动开始分析。
zh.bands.relative_note: 纵轴为相对 dBFS 的频带电平：没有绝对校准，不构成认证声级（SPL）。
zh.bands.offline_only: 离线参考（非 PL 实时）：仅基于已录制 PCM 计算。
zh.bands.centers_note: 横轴按真实 1/3 倍频程中心频率对数等距排列。
zh.bands.no_spl_claim: 本页不显示、也不推断认证声压级。
zh.bands.dbfs_note: 相对 dBFS：不是 dB SPL。
zh.pair.title: 麦对关联
zh.pair.run: 运行离线参考麦对分析
zh.pair.need_replay: 请先在“记录与回放”打开录制文件；本页不会自动开始分析。
zh.pair.coherence_note: 相干性范围 0–1：接近 1 表示该频率两通道线性相关，接近 0 表示不相关。
zh.pair.phase_note: 相位差为 -180°–180° 的相对值；不展开为时延。
zh.pair.csd_note: 互谱密度（CSD）为相对 dB 值，单位以 DTO 为准。
zh.pair.not_doa: 相干性/相位/CSD 不等于波达方向（DOA）或声源定位；界面不显示方向估计。
zh.pair.offline_only: 离线参考（非 PL 实时）：不推断声源方向。
zh.periodic.title: 倒谱
zh.periodic.run: 运行离线参考倒谱分析
zh.periodic.need_replay: 请先在“记录与回放”打开录制文件；本页不会自动开始分析。
zh.periodic.offline_only: 离线参考（非 PL 实时）：不新增前端声学算法。
zh.periodic.no_algorithms: 本页不显示未由后端提供的基频/谐波/边带数值，也不补算。
zh.periodic.quefrency_note: 倒频单位为秒；轴与数值均来自 PL 结果元数据。
zh.periodic.nfft_note: FFT 点数来自检查器设置。
zh.directional.title: 定向功率
zh.directional.explanation: 相对方向功率不等于声源分离。
zh.directional.no_image: 不显示极坐标/空间热图：后端未提供方向功率网格，界面不生成虚构图像。
zh.directional.no_xyz: 不显示 XYZ 坐标、距离或 trackId。
zh.directional.boundary: DAS/自动 DOA 不在本版本范围。
zh.recording_extra.rate_note: 真实采样率与 WAV 整数采样率分别显示；取整误差直接来自清单。
zh.recording_extra.gaps_note: 缺口来自录制清单，不静默压缩或填充。
zh.recording_extra.levels_empty: 尚未计算；只有显式点击“计算离线参考电平”才开始。
zh.recording_extra.no_auto_tasks: 打开录制只读取清单/元数据，不自动启动高成本任务。
zh.recording_extra.export_note: 导出使用后端真实导出通道，不使用前端显示抽取数据。
zh.recording_extra.no_replay_hint: 尚未打开录制文件；回放与离线参考分析都需要先打开。
zh.room.title: 房间声学
zh.room.no_rt60: 不显示 RT60/EDT/T20/T30 或 C50/C80/D50 数值：后端未提供衰减曲线数据，前端不编造。
zh.room.stipa: STIPA 为实验性、未认证指标，需后端提供输入条件后才可显示。
zh.room.boundary: 房间声学服务未接通实时数据。
zh.report_extra.capture_hint: 捕获本页可见图谱为 PNG，保存到用户数据目录的 screenshots 子目录。
zh.report_extra.none: 本页当前没有可捕获的图谱：请先打开录制并运行离线参考分析。
zh.report_extra.title_placeholder: 例如：实验室 1/3 倍频程对比
zh.report_extra.save_hint: 报告保存在用户数据目录的 reports 子目录；数值来自后端 DTO。
zh.report_extra.chart_capture_ok: 图表 PNG 已保存到 screenshots 目录。
zh.report_extra.generate_on_page: 在页面顶部使用“生成报告（含图谱捕获）”完成报告；检查器只编辑元数据字段。
zh.report_extra.title_persisted: 标题与说明会自动保存，并写入报告页脚。
zh.recording_extra.export_default_dir: 默认导出到用户数据目录的 exports 子目录。
zh.spectrum.waterfall_need_frames: 需要设备提供数值频谱帧（最多 48 帧 × 128 频点）；当前数据无法生成曲面。
zh.pl.no_streams: 设备尚未开放实时数据流
zh.pl.wait_capabilities: 等待网关报告可用的 PL 数据流；不会订阅未实现的流。
zh.pl.wait_data: 等待 PL 测量数据
zh.pl.data_note: 仅显示 PL 输出；缺失、过期或未经确认的数据不作为测量结果。
zh.pl.metadata_missing: 图表只在设备提供对应结果及明确的频点、单位和缩放元数据后显示。
zh.pl.record_note: 只记录本设备提供的采样流。录制按钮按设备能力与控制权启用；采样缺口会保存在记录中。
zh.pl.display_settings: 显示设置（不下发 PL 配置）
zh.empty.no_audio: 连接设备并等待 PL 采样流，六通道波形会在收到有效数据后显示。
zh.recording.source_note: 仅记录和导出当前 PL 设备采集的数据。
zh.pl.current_params_note: 参数以设备最近一次发布为准；未接通的功能不会在这里模拟。
zh.studio.device_params: 测量使用设备预设。只有设备返回的有效结果才会显示。
zh.studio.connect_hint: 在顶部连接设备，然后选择要查看的测量项目。
zh.studio.fixed_interface: 通信接口由设备协议固定，端口无需设置。
zh.studio.native_dpi: 界面跟随系统显示缩放，字体和图表以原生分辨率绘制。
zh.studio.export_formats: 测量结果：CSV / JSON；图表：PNG；事件采样：WAV / CSV。可在 MATLAB 等软件中继续分析。
zh.studio.no_events_hint: 启动事件监测后，在这里查看和导出设备捕获的声音。
zh.studio.diagnostics_note: 诊断信息用于排查设备连接和功能可用性，不会修改设备设置。
zh.studio.record_hint: 这里只保存本设备采集的记录。不导入外部音频，不进行离线分析。
zh.studio.export_wait: 先完成一次测量，再导出结果
zh.studio.download_connect: 请先连接设备，下载事件记录
zh.studio.export_done: 已导出，文件可在导出文件夹中查看
zh.studio.update_device: 更新设备软件后即可使用这项测量。
zh.studio.unavailable_hint: 设备暂不支持这项测量，可在连接诊断中查看详情。
zh.studio.experimental: 实验结果 · 非认证测量
zh.studio.noise_estimate: NC/NR 估计 · 基于所声明参考
zh.studio.room_approximate: 近似脉冲响应 · 非认证测量
zh.studio.retained_note: 显示实际保留帧，不代表无遗漏的连续声谱。

en.time.title: Time & level
en.time.gaps_hint: Gaps come from stream metadata; the waveform breaks at gaps and is never silently filled.
en.time.cursor_hint: Wheel-zoom the time axis, drag to pan, double-click to fit; cursors snap to displayed points.
en.time.display_only: Display extraction only: never exported as measurement values.
en.time.channel_hint: Channel visibility is toggled at the top of the page; the six channel colors are fixed app-wide.
en.bands.title: 1/3 octave
en.bands.need_replay: Open a recording in Recording & Replay first; this page never starts analysis automatically.
en.bands.relative_note: The vertical axis is a relative band level in dBFS: without absolute calibration it is not a certified sound level (SPL).
en.bands.offline_only: Offline reference (not PL live): computed only from recorded PCM.
en.bands.centers_note: Categories are placed at true 1/3-octave center frequencies on a log-spaced axis.
en.bands.no_spl_claim: This page shows no certified sound pressure level and infers none.
en.pair.title: Channel pair
en.pair.need_replay: Open a recording in Recording & Replay first; this page never starts analysis automatically.
en.pair.coherence_note: Coherence is 0–1: near 1 means the two channels are linearly related at that frequency, near 0 means unrelated.
en.pair.phase_note: Phase difference is a relative value in -180°–180°; it is not unwrapped into a delay.
en.pair.csd_note: Cross spectral density (CSD) is a relative dB value; units follow the DTO.
en.pair.not_doa: Coherence/phase/CSD are not direction of arrival (DOA) or source localization; no direction estimate is shown.
en.pair.offline_only: Offline reference (not PL live): no source direction is inferred.
en.periodic.title: Cepstrum
en.periodic.need_replay: Open a recording in Recording & Replay first; this page never starts analysis automatically.
en.periodic.offline_only: Offline reference (not PL live); no front-end acoustic algorithm is added.
en.periodic.no_algorithms: This page shows no fundamental/harmonic/sideband value that the backend does not provide, and computes none.
en.periodic.quefrency_note: Quefrency is in seconds; axes and values come from PL result metadata.
en.periodic.nfft_note: FFT size comes from the inspector setting.
en.directional.title: Directional power
en.directional.explanation: Relative directional power is not source separation.
en.directional.no_image: No polar/spatial heatmap is drawn: the backend provides no directional power grid and no fabricated image is generated.
en.directional.no_xyz: No XYZ position, range or trackId is shown.
en.directional.boundary: DAS/automatic DOA are out of scope for this version.
en.recording_extra.rate_note: Real and WAV integer sample rates are shown separately; the rounding error comes from the manifest.
en.recording_extra.gaps_note: Gaps come from the recording manifest and are never silently compressed or filled.
en.recording_extra.levels_empty: Not computed yet; only an explicit click on 'Compute offline reference levels' starts it.
en.recording_extra.no_auto_tasks: Opening a recording only reads manifest/metadata; no high-cost task is started automatically.
en.recording_extra.export_note: Export uses the backend export path, not front-end display extractions.
en.recording_extra.no_replay_hint: No recording opened yet; replay and offline reference analysis both require opening one.
en.room.title: Room acoustics
en.room.no_rt60: No RT60/EDT/T20/T30 or C50/C80/D50 value is shown: the backend provides no decay data and the front end fabricates none.
en.room.stipa: STIPA is experimental and uncertified; it can only be shown once the backend provides its input conditions.
en.room.boundary: Room acoustics services have no live data path.
en.report_extra.capture_hint: Captures this page's visible charts as PNG files under the user data screenshots directory.
en.report_extra.none: No chart is available to capture right now; open a recording and run offline reference analysis first.
en.report_extra.save_hint: Reports are saved under the user data reports directory; values come from backend DTOs.
en.report_extra.chart_capture_ok: Chart PNG files were saved under screenshots.
en.report_extra.generate_on_page: Use 'Generate report (captures charts)' at the top of the page; the inspector only edits metadata fields.
en.report_extra.title_persisted: Title and note are saved automatically and included in the report footer.
en.recording_extra.export_default_dir: Exports default to the exports directory in the user data folder.
en.spectrum.waterfall_need_frames: Requires numeric spectrum frames from the device (up to 48 frames × 128 bins).
en.pl.no_streams: Device has no available live streams
en.pl.wait_capabilities: Waiting for advertised PL streams. Unimplemented streams are not requested.
en.pl.data_note: PL output only. Missing, stale or unverified data is not a measurement result.
en.pl.metadata_missing: Plots appear only when the device supplies the result with explicit axes, units and scaling metadata.
en.pl.record_note: Records only this device stream. Recording requires device capability and control ownership; gaps remain in the record.
en.empty.no_audio: Connect the device and wait for valid PL sample streams to display six-channel waveforms.
en.recording.source_note: Records and exports only data captured by this PL device.
en.pl.current_params_note: Parameters reflect the latest device publication; unconnected features are not simulated here.
en.studio.device_params: Uses device presets. Only valid device results are shown.
en.studio.connect_hint: Connect the device above, then select a measurement.
en.studio.fixed_interface: Communication ports are fixed by the device protocol.
en.studio.native_dpi: Native rendering follows the system display scale.
en.studio.export_formats: Measurements: CSV / JSON. Charts: PNG. Event samples: WAV / CSV. Compatible with MATLAB and other analysis tools.
en.studio.no_events_hint: Start monitoring to inspect and export device-captured audio.
en.studio.diagnostics_note: Diagnostics inspect connectivity and feature availability without changing device settings.
en.studio.record_hint: Saves only this device’s recordings. No external audio import or offline analysis.
en.studio.download_connect: Connect the device to download the event recording
en.studio.export_done: Export complete. Open the exports folder to view the files.
en.studio.update_device: Update the device software to use this measurement.
en.studio.unavailable_hint: This measurement is not currently supported. See connection diagnostics for details.
en.studio.retained_note: Retained snapshots only; not a gap-free continuous spectrogram.
